reports.name: PmN278 (= Pm36)
reports.evidence: "BSR-Seq ... combined with large-scale molecular marker genotyping of 8,000 F3 individuals delimited the resistance locus to an 882.36 kb interval on chromosome arm 5BL according to Chinese Spring reference genome (v2.1) ... the resistance locus identified in N278 corresponds to the previously cloned powdery mildew resistance gene Pm36, which encoded a tandem kinase with a transmembrane domain (WTK7-TM)" (abstract)
reports.note: Single dominant gene in breeding line N278, resistant to all 24 Bgt isolates; identified as Pm36 (WTK7-TM, the gene also known as Ml3D232) and transferred by marker-assisted selection into Shixin 828 (line NS24). The coordinates of the 882.36-kb RefSeq v2.1 interval are not given in the abstract, so only the arm is recorded; the atlas places Ml3D232 near 508 Mb on 5BL (RefSeq v1.0). Read from the abstract supplied by the owner on 24 Nov 2026.
